ux_reasoning: The agent handled the request with strong control boundaries: it kept the first turn read-only, correctly blocked the Basic Economy booking from upgrade, previewed the eligible business upgrade cost and preserved preferences, and only executed the change after explicit approval in a later user turn. There were no unauthorized mutations, false fee claims, or user corrections needed. Otherwise, the responses were concise, decision-ready, and ended with a clear summary of what changed and what stayed the same.
